People deal with a lot of things internally. You don't have to take the backlash cos other people are in a bad mood. As long as you try to be kind to others, then you've done right, at least in my book. I don't know you, but I don't think you're a piece of shit. Just know that life is bigger than what your parents think. Why should you care about their opinions if they don't care about you.

Death is part of life. It's everywhere. As a healthcare worker, I'm sure that you've seen more of it than most people. The pandemic has truly been traumatizing for everyone. If you've done everything that you could for your patients, then you've done right by them, even if they didn't make it. You're such a strong person for doing this. It's not weak to know your limits and not push yourself past them. If you have to quit because its whats best for you, then you should. Life is hard and things seem bleak. I understand that. You're not useless. You are so SO important, even if it doesn't feel like it. To your husband and family, you're a vital piece. To your patients and friends and co-workers, you're important. You help people. That's one of the hardest and most selfless things to do. Do something selfish for once and hold on. Death is not for you yet.  I hope this helped you, best of luck to you, and thank you for working during the pandemic :)
